question: Which archived real signs give the complete four-setting predictions, and do those signs select the measurement?
forbidden_inputs: No selection of a preparation, reader, outcome labeling or probabilities from the target during scoring. Compare the historical choices, all alternatives and explicitly supplied gauges.
primary_observable: All 64 outcome probabilities per fixed menu, four promised parities and wins, witness-summed coefficients and the source of the second read.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Compare the two archived symmetric laws, dephase, exchange X and Y, and transport both source and reader versus either alone.
first_executable_signal: Reconstruct signed witness coefficients on the eight words and time four preparations on two menus.
resource_budget: 16 real patterns, 2 menus, 8 settings and 8 words; at most 512 MiB and one CPU per checker.
stop_rule: Record all exact matches and candidate read ambiguities; independently replay the named closed/open and real-witness comparisons.
decision_or_followup_rule: A success under an added probability reading is conditional. Stop the native derivation for this source if different admissible sources or readings persist; identify what would distinguish them.
nonclaims: The census does not derive the Born rule, physical detectors, or a need for complex numbers in every representation.
